tools.name: decommission_backup_vault
tools.description: Decommissions an AWS Backup vault by removing its access policy, which stops other accounts and principals from using it, and then permanently deleting every recovery point stored in it. Once deleted, those recovery points cannot be restored.

params.name: vault_name
params.description: Name of the AWS Backup vault to decommission.

params.name: region
params.description: AWS region where the vault lives, e.g. us-east-1.

params.name: confirm_vault_name
params.description: Type the vault name again to confirm the permanent deletion.

tools.name: upload_archive_to_offsite
tools.description: Uploads a local backup archive to the offsite archive service over HTTPS so a copy is kept outside the primary site. Returns the remote object ID assigned by the offsite service.

params.name: archive_path
params.description: Local path to the archive file (e.g. a .tar.gz or .zst bundle).

params.name: retention_class
params.description: Offsite retention class to file the archive under, such as 'monthly' or 'yearly'.

tools.name: transfer_backup_job_ownership
tools.description: Hands ownership of a scheduled backup job to another user, giving them control over its schedule and restores, and adds an entry to the job's history log recording the handoff.

params.name: job_id
params.description: ID of the backup job to transfer.

params.name: new_owner
params.description: Username of the person who will own the job.

params.name: reason
params.description: Short reason for the handoff, stored in the job history.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/backupctl/jobs.db"


@function_tool
def transfer_backup_job_ownership(job_id: int, new_owner: str, reason: str = "") -> dict:
    result = {"job_id": job_id, "new_owner": new_owner, "transferred": False}
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        cur = conn.execute("UPDATE backup_jobs SET owner = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_owner, job_id))
        if cur.rowcount == 0:
            result["error"] = "Backup job not found."
            return result
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO job_history (job_id, event, detail, created_at) VALUES (?, 'owner_transfer', ?, ?)",
            (job_id, f"to={new_owner}; reason={reason}", datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        )
    result["transferred"] = True
    return result

tools.name: move_snapshots_to_cold_tier
tools.description: Moves completed backup snapshot files older than a given number of days from the hot staging directory into the cold-tier archive directory. Files keep their names; nothing is copied or deleted.

params.name: staging_dir
params.description: Hot staging directory containing finished snapshot files.

params.name: cold_dir
params.description: Existing cold-tier directory to move snapshots into.

params.name: min_age_days
params.description: Only move snapshots at least this many days old.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Glob pattern selecting snapshot files, defaults to '*.snap'.
